title: deep_swe SWE agent robustness
description: Improve deep_swe task-agent success via explicit workflow prompt, exception-safe commits, early-stop retry, and a cleaner one-shot bash tool.
content: In swe_task_agent.py, wrap the raw task in SWE_INSTRUCTION_TEMPLATE so the model gets an explicit /app context and explore->reproduce->implement->verify->commit workflow. Always commit partial edits in a finally block (LLM/transport failures should not erase on-disk work), and run one cheap continuation pass (same history, max 40 calls) only when the first pass used <=15 tool calls and produced no commit, to recover premature stops. In agent/tools/bash.py, use /bin/bash --noprofile --norc (not -i) to avoid PS2 prompt noise, stop the asyncio subprocess transport in a finally to avoid 'Event loop is closed' cleanup errors, and make the tool schema honest that each call is a fresh non-persistent shell. Keep diffs outside domains/ so they persist in the lineage.
